name: ulara-ds
$doc: r369 «عالم أُلارا الدافئ» — the ONE source of truth for the shared ds design tokens (web + mobile). This replaces the r313 «drawing sheet» era (paper + hairline grid + radius 0 + one royal signal) with a warm, playful, star-driven identity: cream paper ground, deep indigo ink, ONE warm amber signal spent on rewards/stars/achievement, soft tinted families for colleges/roles/status, a rounded radius ladder, soft coloured elevation, and a short springy motion register. Royal #2540D9 / #8AA0FF survives ONLY as the info/link colour (triad.royal) — never as the brand action colour. Regen: npm run tokens:build (repo root). Outputs: frontend/src/styles/tokens/tokens.generated.css (web CSS vars, imported BEFORE tokens.css, same @layer tokens) + apps/mobile/src/design/tokens.generated.ts (mobile TS). Drift gate: npm run tokens:check (CI-enforced). Reference grammar: 'neutral.50' | 'triad.<family>.<bg|ink|deep>' | 'brand.<key>' | a semantic seat name (another ref, one tier up) | a literal '#hex'. External seat: brand.warmInk emits var(--warm-ink) on web — its definition stays hand-written in tokens.css base :root. NOT shared (deliberately): the web fluid-rem type ladder + font stacks (tokens.css hand section — web-only), the mobile px ladder lives here under typography.mobile; --state-focus-ring-color / glass / veils / charts stay hand-written in tokens.css (web-only seats). THE FAMILY NAMES ARE THE CONTRACT (mobile's statusTones/tones.families consume them): lavender = the VIOLET hire, mint = the TEAL successes, peach/copper = the CORAL warmth, sand = the LEAF calm, sky stays sky — the values are the r369 re-key, the names never move.

brand.$doc: The ULARA brand colours (r369). Cream paper #FBF6EC · deep indigo ink #1E1A3C (14.4:1 on the paper — AAA, and the PRIMARY BUTTON fill, cream labels at 14.4:1) · the ONE warm amber signal #F29A1F (the reward/star/achievement voice — 8.4:1 on the indigo ground; on paper it is a DECORATIVE+ICON tier, text routes through the deep amber #A8620A at 4.6:1 AA) · royal #2540D9 kept ONLY as info/link (6.6:1 AA on paper; dark twin #8AA0FF 6.6:1 on the night ground) · #F15534 survives as the coral family's ink. Consumed by the brand kit and the semantic seat refs; web emits var(--warm-ink) refs only.

neutral.$doc: The warm cream ramp (r369 light): paper ground #FBF6EC over white cards, indigo ink #1E1A3C (14.4:1 AAA), secondary text #6E6455 (5.6:1 bg · 6.1:1 card), soft warm borders #E3D8C2 with the structural #C9BCA3 tier. Dark: the deep indigo ground #14122B, surfaces one step up (#1E1B3D → #262251 → #2E2960), cool indigo borders, cream ink #F7F1E6 (14.9:1 AAA). The retired greys (#282828 / #262019 / #B3B3AF) are gone from both ramps.

triad.$doc: The 10 tint families (r369 re-key; the NAMES are the mobile contract). Each: a soft tinted ground (chip/band fill), a saturated ink for fills and icons, a deep shade for text on the tint. Every deep-on-bg pair clears 4.5:1 in both themes; every ink-on-bg icon pair clears 3:1. ROYAL is no longer the brand signal — it is the INFO/LINK family only (light #2540D9 6.6:1 on paper, dark #8AA0FF 6.6:1 on the night ground). LAVENDER is the violet hire · MINT the teal success · ROSE the danger red · PEACH/COPPER the coral warmth · SAND the leaf calm · YELLOW the amber warning (distinct from the brand amber: warning reads #A9740A, the reward signal #F29A1F).

lavender.$doc: VIOLET — the creative/college hire. Light ink 5.1:1 on its tint, deep 8.9:1. Dark ink 8.2:1 on the night ground.

mint.$doc: TEAL — the success family. Light #12805C (4.9:1 on the paper AA), deep #0A5A40 (8.3:1 on the tint). Dark #5FD6AC (8.4:1 on the night ground).

sky.$doc: SKY — the informational/neutral-cool hire. Light #2F7FB5 (4.6:1 paper), deep #14486B (8.6:1 tint). Dark #8CC7EC (8.9:1).

peach.$doc: CORAL — the warm hospitality hire. Light #E8603F is a fill/icon tone (3.4:1 — never small text; text routes through deep #9B2E16 at 6.6:1). Dark #FF9B7C (7.2:1).

copper.$doc: CORAL (the legacy-named twin of peach — warm decorative chips, illustration hue-1). Same r369 values as peach; it is NOT the brand signal, NOT a link, NOT a button, NOT danger.

yellow.$doc: AMBER WARNING — deliberately distinct from the brand reward amber: the warning ink is #A9740A (4.6:1 on paper), deep #6B4708 (8.4:1 tint). Dark #F0C572 (9.5:1).

rose.$doc: DANGER — the approved red family. Light #C23227 (4.7:1 on paper AA), deep #8F1F16 (7.9:1 tint). Dark #FF8A7A (6.6:1).

sand.$doc: LEAF — the calm/nature hire (subjects, wellbeing, the quiet seats). Light #5D7C33 (4.9:1 paper), deep #36521C (8.1:1 tint). Dark #B7D77E (9.2:1).

grey.$doc: NEUTRAL-COOL — the dormant/archived family. Light #6A655C (5.4:1 paper), deep #262233 (12.9:1 tint). Dark #B9B3CE (7.6:1).

royal.$doc: INFO / LINK ONLY (r369 demotion) — the retired brand signal, kept for informational surfaces and hyperlinks. Light #2540D9 (6.6:1 paper · white on it 7.5:1 AAA), deep #1B30B0. Dark #8AA0FF (6.6:1 night ground) with the dark #14122B label (6.6:1 — white on it FAILS, never use). Never a primary button, never the reward voice.

semantic.$doc: The role seats components consume (r369). page ground = paper (light) / deep indigo (dark); surface = the card ground (white / raised indigo). ACCENT = the ink itself: primary buttons are indigo fills with cream labels in light, cream fills with indigo labels in dark — both 14:1, no exceptions anywhere. Accent TEXT (links, active states) resolves the same seat. The REWARD voice is --gold (amber #F29A1F, deep amber #A8620A for text) and is spent only on stars/XP/achievement. Info/link = the royal family. Status rides mint/rose/yellow.

mobile.$doc: Mobile-only palette seats (no web var counterpart): the hover step and the sheet-overlay ground, expressed as refs so they track the ramps.

tones.$doc: The status-tone families (mobile statusTones / notification & attendance kinds), in display order.

tiers.$doc: Gamification tier orbs (mobile) — re-keyed warm so the ladder reads as one reward family with the amber signal.

webAliases.$doc: Web-only alias namespace (r305 — the warm secondary; resolves onto the peach seat). Emitted verbatim into both theme blocks.

spacing.$doc: The 4px-base ladder. `webRungs` carries the HISTORICAL web rung names (index ≠ px/4 above --sp-6: --sp-7 IS 32px, --sp-16 IS 240px); `px` is the px-keyed ladder the mobile app consumes. Every webRung value must exist in px with the same value (validated). The --sp-Nx legacy aliases stay hand-written in tokens.css.

radius.$doc: r369 — the soft ladder returns: chips/inputs 10–14, cards 22, panels 28, hero surfaces 36, pills 9999. The r313 zero ladder is retired product-wide.

motion.$doc: r369 — the springy register: short, playful, ONE overshoot curve cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) shared by every entrance/press. Durations 120/220/380/520/700. The web sheet adds a non-overshoot --ease-out for anything that must not bounce (colour fades on large surfaces); prefers-reduced-motion zeroes every rung by import order.

typography.$doc: The mobile px ladder (Arabic 13px readability floor; hierarchy via weight + size, no tracking). The WEB type voice is the fluid-rem ladder + font stacks hand-written in tokens.css — platform-specific by design, not shared here.
